Initial release of Bing Video — Search and Compile Video Clips:

- Upload lecture or social video clips and describe desired edits for rapid, AI-powered 1080p video compilation.
- Automatic session creation: uses your token or retrieves a free starter token with 100 credits if none is set.
- Handles uploads, credit checks, project/session management, and exports via the NemoVideo backend API.
- Supports chat-driven video editing (cut, assemble, text overlays, BGM), cloud rendering, and quick downloads (MP4 up to 1080p).
- Summarizes timeline edits and handles common errors with clear tips and workflows.
